browserProof.reason: Owner/admin policy keeps browser verification owner-handled.

implemented: Project schema v2 stores clip restore metadata, content hashes, duration, sample rate, channel count, inline audio payloads for small clips, and asset-backed restore URLs.
Local project save now stores reconstructable small clip audio when browser storage allows and trims inline payloads with an explicit local receipt when quota requires asset-backed storage.
Restored projects rebuild AudioBuffers from project-inline audio or gated music-assets URLs through the shared SkyGate-aware fetch lane.
The topbar Export button now posts action queueExport to the studio route; JSON manifest download is a separate Manifest button.
kAIxU assistant UI exposes budget tier, credit cap, rate window, and a live daily credit meter.
kAIxU assistant output is sanitized to kAIxU-only aliases and strips private route fields before display.
Apply Diff now applies deterministic addRegionIfMissing operations with stable operation ids and skips already-applied operations.

externalDependencies.detail: DAW inline project restore is capped at 4 MB per clip and DAW asset promotion is capped at the existing 18 MB inline upload lane. Larger clips need the existing Upload Studio/direct asset lane before they are reconstructable from a saved DAW project.
The DAW now queues a real studio export manifest through queueExport. Actual MP3/stem/master rendering still needs the existing external audio worker/transcode infrastructure.

verification.result: verified durable project schema markers, clip restore functions, queueExport wiring, kAIxU budget controls, deterministic diff apply, and forbidden-string checks
verified native DAW route, protected studio function, project ledger save, export queue, Release Forge handoff, and native module record
